hidden_homeroom_d3_low.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_low.text: *At the empty classroom door, your homeroom teacher stops and points down the hall instead of toward the desks.* Let's keep it to classwork today.

hidden_homeroom_d3_neg.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_neg.text: *She only points down the hall.* Personal talk ends here.

hidden_nurse_d3_low.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_low.text: *The school nurse stays by the door without pulling out the counseling chair.* I don't think we should continue this conversation alone right now. If you need something, come during official counseling hours.

hidden_nurse_d3_neg.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_neg.text: *She doesn't pull out a chair.* Official desk only. Go back.

morning3_date_seo_low.name: Seoyeon
morning3_date_seo_low.text: *Seoyeon turns on her phone, then immediately switches it off. When your eyes meet, she looks down at her clipboard.* I'll post the weekend schedule in the group chat.

morning3_date_dain_low.name: Dain
morning3_date_dain_low.text: *Dain glances my way, then zips up her bag.* I’m practicing on my own this weekend.

morning3_date_yuna_low.name: Yuna
morning3_date_yuna_low.text: *Yuna starts to pull out a folded note, then slips it back between the pages of her book.* This weekend... I think I'd rather be alone.

morning3_start.name: {name}
morning3_start.text: *Day three. After lingering over messages last night, I dismissed the alarm three times and overslept.*

morning3_start_2.name: {name}
morning3_start_2.text: *I run, gripping my bag strap. Someone stands at the gate.*

morning3_seo_gate_1.name: {name}
morning3_seo_gate_1.text: Seoyeon? Why are you still here? The bell's about to ring. Don't you need to go in? *She stands at the gate without even shifting her feet.*

morning3_seo_gate_warm_1.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_warm_1.text: *Unlike usual, she's waiting at the gate.*

morning3_seo_gate_warm_2.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_warm_2.text: I was out here on student council business. Then I happened to see you.

morning3_seo_gate_warm_3.name: {name}
morning3_seo_gate_warm_3.text: *Seoyeon's hands are empty. No papers or clipboard.*

morning3_seo_gate_warm_4.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_warm_4.text: Take your time, {name}. We're still okay. *She slows her steps.*

morning3_seo_gate_4.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_4.text: So what if we're late. Beats getting scolded alone.

morning3_seo_gate_5.name: {name}
morning3_seo_gate_5.text: Pretty sure that's not how it works.

morning3_seo_gate_6.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_6.text: I'm joking. I'll explain why we were both late.

morning3_seo_gate_6_b.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_6_b.text: *She shows the student council schedule to the teacher on gate duty.*

morning3_seo_gate_7.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_7.text: It's approved. Let's go in. *She folds the stamped schedule.*

morning3_seo_gate_cold_1.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_cold_1.text: *As Seoyeon passes, only her eyes shift toward my name tag.*

morning3_seo_gate_cold_2.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_cold_2.text: Transfer student. So you're still here.

morning3_seo_gate_cold_3.name: {name}
morning3_seo_gate_cold_3.text: *She doesn't even say my name. Only the sound of her heels recedes through the gate.*

morning3_yuna_gate_1.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_1.text: *At the gate, Yuna looks at the toes of her sneakers, her eyes half shut.*

morning3_yuna_gate_warm_1.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_warm_1.text: *Yuna is leaning against the wall by the gate. She hands me a note.*

morning3_yuna_gate_warm_3.name: Yuna
morning3_yuna_gate_warm_3.text: *One short line on the note Yuna offers.* I was waiting.

morning3_yuna_gate_warm_4.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_warm_4.text: I read your note. Thanks for waiting. *I walk beside Yuna.*

morning3_yuna_gate_3.name: Yuna
morning3_yuna_gate_3.text: I stayed up all night reading.

morning3_yuna_gate_5.name: Yuna
morning3_yuna_gate_5.text: I wanted to know how it ended. I couldn't put it down.

morning3_yuna_gate_6.name: Yuna
morning3_yuna_gate_6.text: Have half. This is enough for me. *She splits the bread. A lavender note shows under the bag.*

morning3_yuna_gate_6_b.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_6_b.text: *The note reads, 'You didn't eat breakfast, did you?' A little lavender ink has smudged onto the bottom of the bread bag.*

morning3_yuna_gate_7.name: Yuna
morning3_yuna_gate_7.text: Eat as we walk. Keep the crumbs out of your bag. ...Give me the wrapper. *We share the bread through the gate; she folds the empty bag.*

morning3_yuna_gate_cold_1.name: Yuna
morning3_yuna_gate_cold_1.text: *When our eyes meet, Yuna presses her book closer to her chest and goes through the gate first.*

morning3_yuna_gate_cold_2.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_cold_2.text: *Yuna speeds up to close the gap with the person ahead. There is no opening to speak to her.*

morning3_dain_gate_1.name: {name}
morning3_dain_gate_1.text: *Near the gate, Dain comes sprinting at full speed.*

morning3_dain_gate_warm_1.name: Dain
morning3_dain_gate_warm_1.text: *Dain pulls up beside me and offers her elbow, out of breath.*

morning3_dain_gate_warm_2.name: Dain
morning3_dain_gate_warm_2.text: Yo! You almost made us late! Come on, let's go!

morning3_dain_gate_warm_3.name: Dain
morning3_dain_gate_warm_3.text: This pace okay, {name}? *She hooks my elbow and slows down.*

morning3_dain_gate_3.name: Dain
morning3_dain_gate_3.text: Here, take my hand. We can start together. No fun if I go first on my own. *She offers her palm and crouches as if at a starting line.*

morning3_dain_gate_4.name: {name}
morning3_dain_gate_4.text: Forget the hand. Let's run together.

morning3_dain_gate_5.name: {name}
morning3_dain_gate_5.text: *We speed up together. The gate draws closer.*

morning3_dain_gate_5_b.name: Dain
morning3_dain_gate_5_b.text: Ugh... Come on, let's go! *Her right foot follows half a beat late.*

morning3_dain_gate_cold_1.name: Dain
morning3_dain_gate_cold_1.text: *She runs past with her other friends.*

morning3_classroom_1.name: {name}
morning3_classroom_1.text: *As I enter the classroom, Seoyeon's pen stops and Dain's chair slides back. Yuna marks the same page twice.*

morning3_react_seo_1.name: Dain
morning3_react_seo_1.text: Wait, you came in with the council president? First thing in the morning?

morning3_react_seo_2.name: Yuna
morning3_react_seo_2.text: *Yuna, staring outside, spots {name}'s reflection in the glass and pushes her bookmark one notch deeper.*

morning3_react_yuna_1.name: Seoyeon
morning3_react_yuna_1.text: Walking to school together now? Cozy.

morning3_react_yuna_1_b.name: Dain
morning3_react_yuna_1_b.text: *Dain turns around, chair and all, to look this way.*

morning3_react_yuna_2.name: Dain
morning3_react_yuna_2.text: I'm jealous! I don't have anyone to walk to school with in the morning.

morning3_react_yuna_2_b.name: Seoyeon
morning3_react_yuna_2_b.text: *She stops in front of the classroom door.*

morning3_react_dain_1.name: Seoyeon
morning3_react_dain_1.text: Morning workout wore you out. Want my lunchbox at lunch?

morning3_react_dain_2.name: Yuna
morning3_react_dain_2.text: *Head down, she draws a short line at the paper's edge.*

morning3_date_intro.name: {name}
morning3_date_intro.text: *First period ends. Someone comes to talk to me during every break.*

morning3_date_intro_b.name: {name}
morning3_date_intro_b.text: *Break in the hall. Seoyeon matches my pace.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_1.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_1.text: Oh, you're here. *The pen stops at the desk in the empty classroom.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_3.text: *The tip of her pen leaves a single dot on the paper.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_3_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_3_b.text: *My homeroom teacher covers the manuscript with her palm and turns the page over.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_4.text: It's nothing. Work documents. Being observant is a strength, but sometimes it's a weakness.

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_b.text: *Dense handwriting shows between the overturned sheets. Her palm covers a corner.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_c.text: *She pulls the attendance book over the manuscript, but the edge of the overturned page remains exposed.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_d.text: What are you looking at? Why are you here during break?

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_e.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_e.text: *The manuscript page lies face down, covered in dense handwriting. Should I ask, or pretend I didn't notice?*

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_f.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_f.text: *I stop before the attendance book, grades, and student records.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_g.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_g.text: *Red ink beneath the manuscript: “On hold.” Her hand presses harder.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_h.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_h.text: *I could have pretended not to notice. The teacher doesn't cover the paper. Closes the pen cap, then opens it again.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_choice.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_choice.text: *It's manuscript paper. She covers the edge with her palm.*
choices: I saw the manuscript paper. Are you writing a novel?
Sorry, I didn't see anything.
Let me be the first to read it when it’s finished.
I’ll read it and point out what needs fixing first.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1.text: It's too rough to call a novel, but I've been at it too long to call it practice. Seven years.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1_c.text: Seven years. I started in college, when I was studying creative writing.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1_e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1_e.text: I submitted it a few times after graduation. It was rejected. After that, sending out job applications felt easier.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1_f.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1_f.text: *The teacher lifts a sheet of manuscript paper. It's covered in dense handwriting.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2.text: The last time I waited for a result, no one called. Around then, I started preparing to become a teacher.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_b.text: I thought I'd put it away once I got a job. But every time I moved drawers, it came along.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_c.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_c.text: So it made it all the way here.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_d.text: *She squares the manuscript, then finally sighs.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_e.text: It's easier if I think of it as just paper.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_f.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_f.text: *She rubs a corner of the manuscript, then leans back in her chair.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_3.text: That's how I became a language arts teacher. Funny, isn't it? I'm still holding on to these pages.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_3_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_3_c.text: *She puts down the manuscript, releasing it a beat later.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4.text: It would be easier to call it giving up. But if I still take it out in empty classrooms like this, I guess I never managed to.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_b.text: *Worn manuscript edges. The teacher rests her hand on a blank line.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_c.text: *She sets the manuscript apart from the attendance book.* It's something I wrote on my own. It has nothing to do with class, and you don't have to force yourself to read it.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_d.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_d.text: Am I not allowed to read it?

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_e.text: I’m planning to bring it to the writing club’s critique session. Would you read it then?

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_f.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_f.text: *Finished speaking, she still rubs the manuscript corner with her thumb.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_g.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_g.text: When you share it there, I'd like to read it.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice.text: *Seven years. The manuscript paper on the desk is worn thin.*
choices: Seven years isn't giving up — that's persistence
Why do you always write here?
After seven years, isn't it time to let it go?

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice_trap.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice_trap.text: *The teacher closes the manuscript.* I've heard that plenty of times already.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice_a.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice_a.text: *Her thumb, smoothing the corner of the manuscript, presses down against the page.* Calling it persistence makes it feel a little less pathetic.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice_b.text: The classroom is the quietest place. Ironic, isn't it?

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_5.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_5.text: I'm planning to show it to the other language arts teachers this week too. If I keep hiding it, I don't think I'll ever finish it.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6.text: *She presses her lips together once, then releases them, but doesn't fold the manuscript away.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_b.text: I’ve been revising it on my own. This time I’ll get to hear people’s reactions in person.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_c.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_c.text: *She clears her throat and squares the manuscript. Ticking between her words.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_d.text: Thank you. If you hadn't asked first, I might have put it away again.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_e.text: *The manuscript corner creases under her thumb.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_f.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_f.text: Anyway, let’s talk more about the manuscript at the critique session.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_g.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_g.text: I'll put the rest in the envelope. *Her hand pauses before the last sheet.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_hide_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_hide_1.text: All right. Let's leave it closed for now. When I'm ready to share it, I'll tell the literature club first.

hidden_homeroom_d3_end.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_end.text: *She closes the manuscript and opens the window beside the lectern. Noise from the hall drifts in, then fades.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_freetalk.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_freetalk.text: *She files the manuscript and stands by the desk.* A surprise, I imagine. We can talk for a moment. The manuscript feedback can wait for the public workshop.
hidden_homeroom_d3_freetalk.context: Day 3 morning. In an empty classroom, a student found the homeroom teacher's personal novel manuscript. She does not ask the student to keep it secret or give private feedback; she is considering submitting it for an open critique at the literature club.
hidden_homeroom_d3_freetalk.personality: The homeroom teacher once hoped to become a novelist. She never stopped writing after becoming a teacher, but she tries to keep her private creative work separate from her role in teaching and evaluating students.

hidden_nurse_d3_1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_1.text: *Next break, I head to the infirmary. The edge of the bandage on my elbow catches on my sleeve.*

hidden_nurse_d3_1_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_1_b.text: *The nurse rises from her desk.* Hm? Where are you hurt today?

hidden_nurse_d3_1_d.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_1_d.text: Not hurt but coming to the nurse's office?

hidden_nurse_d3_1_e.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_1_e.text: I just wanted to rest a bit.

hidden_nurse_d3_2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_2.text: Nothing hurts? You don't look well.

hidden_nurse_d3_3.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_3.text: I just wanted to rest. Things with people are getting complicated.

hidden_nurse_d3_4.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_4.text: *The nurse draws the curtain and hands me a cup of water.* Sit down. You can relax in here. Take your time.

hidden_nurse_d3_5_d.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_5_d.text: *The nurse's thumb presses once against the rim of the paper cup.*

hidden_nurse_d3_5_e.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_5_e.text: Things that are hard to bring up with anyone.

hidden_nurse_d3_5_g.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_5_g.text: I keep putting off answers because I’m afraid of disappointing someone.

hidden_nurse_d3_5_h.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_5_h.text: *She sets the paper cup neatly on the desk.*

hidden_nurse_d3_5_k.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_5_k.text: Your face says too much for you to deny it.

hidden_nurse_d3_5_l.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_5_l.text: *I look only at the paper cup on the desk.*

hidden_nurse_d3_5_m.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_5_m.text: I'm not sure this counts as school health care. I'll listen anyway. The bed is free.

hidden_nurse_d3_5_n.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_5_n.text: Have you ever tried to look after everyone and found it was too much?

hidden_nurse_d3_5_o.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_5_o.text: Give me a moment. Your question brings it back. ...Where do I start? *The cup rim folds beneath her thumb. She looks outside.*

hidden_nurse_d3_5_p.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_5_p.text: Yeah. Back when I worked at the university hospital.

hidden_nurse_d3_choice1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_choice1.text: *I open my mouth, then close it again.*
choices: What happened back then?
You don't have to tell me if it's hard to talk about.
Did you come to the school because you hated the hospital?

hidden_nurse_d3_choice1_a.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_choice1_a.text: I think I can tell it once. It's a story I should sort out for myself too.

hidden_nurse_d3_choice1_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_choice1_b.text: It's okay. I won't go into the details.

hidden_nurse_d3_choice1_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_choice1_c.text: I didn't run away because I hated it. It isn't that simple.

hidden_nurse_d3_6.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_6.text: At the university hospital, when several call bells went off, all I could think about was where to go first. Often I had to rush away before a patient had finished speaking.

hidden_nurse_d3_6_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_6_b.text: *She sets the cup down; moisture spreads in a circle beneath it.*

hidden_nurse_d3_6_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_6_c.text: I didn’t think I could keep going.

hidden_nurse_d3_6_d.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_6_d.text: Before you came here, what happened at that hospital? If it's hard to talk about... *While putting away her stethoscope, she pulls her hand back before opening the drawer with the notebook.*

hidden_nurse_d3_6_e.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_6_e.text: There was. One patient I couldn't save. Seventeen years old. That's what brought me here.

hidden_nurse_d3_6_f.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_6_f.text: *I remember the pale green notebook from yesterday. The letter that stopped on its first page.*

hidden_nurse_d3_7.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_7.text: That's why I came here. At a school, you can really look at each person.

hidden_nurse_d3_8.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_8.text: Tell people what you can actually do. Do not promise everything is fine and struggle alone afterward. You can ask for help.

hidden_nurse_d3_8_b.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_8_b.text: *One side of the paper cup buckles around the shape of her fingers.*

hidden_nurse_d3_8_d.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_8_d.text: If it's this hard to carry, don't keep it to yourself. I can connect you with the counseling center if you need it.

hidden_nurse_d3_8_e.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_8_e.text: *I fold and pocket the card with the counseling office number.*

hidden_nurse_d3_8_f.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_8_f.text: *I stand and take hold of the door handle. When a drawer opens behind me, I picture the corner of the pale-green notebook.*

hidden_nurse_d3_8_g.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_8_g.text: *I press down the lifted end of the bandage with my nail. Beyond the swaying curtain, I can see the nameplate labeled “School Nurse.”*

hidden_nurse_d3_8_h.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_8_h.text: Miss, just a moment. *I release the handle and turn. Paper folds inside the drawer.*

hidden_nurse_d3_choice2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_choice2.text: *The nurse closes the drawer. I stand by the door, choosing my words.*
choices: Is that why you left the hospital?
Are you okay talking more about it?
Wouldn't you feel better if you told me everything?

hidden_nurse_d3_choice2_a.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_choice2_a.text: Yeah. If I'd stayed any longer, I thought my hands might start shaking in front of another patient.

hidden_nurse_d3_choice2_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_choice2_b.text: Yeah. I'll only say as much as I can handle.

hidden_nurse_d3_choice2_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_choice2_c.text: The person speaking decides whether talking helps—not the listener who keeps pushing.

hidden_nurse_d3_9.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_9.text: You're welcome to come here. But I can't promise I'll solve everything for you on my own.

hidden_nurse_d3_9_b.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_9_b.text: *I put down the paper cup and retrieve the card from my pocket.*

hidden_nurse_d3_9_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_9_c.text: If things get harder for you, I'll work with your homeroom teacher or the counseling center.

hidden_nurse_d3_9_d.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_9_d.text: And before that, you and I will decide who to tell and how much.

hidden_nurse_d3_9_e.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_9_e.text: *She slides the consultation booking sheet forward.*

hidden_nurse_d3_9_f.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_9_f.text: *The sheet lists the nurse's office and counseling center hours side by side. She circles one open slot.*

hidden_nurse_d3_11.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_11.text: There is a little time before class. You can ask anything else you wanted to ask.

hidden_nurse_d3_freetalk.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_freetalk.text: *She draws the curtain halfway and pulls over a chair.* Counseling first, jokes later.
hidden_nurse_d3_freetalk.context: Day 3. The student came to the infirmary for formal counseling after relationships became complicated, and the school nurse shared her experience of burnout at a university hospital. She keeps her experience separate from the student's burden.
hidden_nurse_d3_freetalk.personality: The school nurse is an experienced medical professional with an easygoing sense of humor. She can discuss her burnout without making the student responsible for her recovery and maintains professional boundaries.

morning3_date_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
morning3_date_seo_1.text: Are you free this weekend? Let's go to the park together.

morning3_date_seo_choice.name: Seoyeon
morning3_date_seo_choice.text: *Seoyeon asks from the classroom doorway. The cap on Dain's water bottle stops turning.*
choices: Sure. What time?
I might be kind of busy.
You’re the student council president. Of course I’ll make time for you.
I’ll clear my schedule if no one else is coming.

morning3_date_seo_accept.name: {name}
morning3_date_seo_accept.text: Yeah, see you this weekend. *I arrange to meet Seoyeon; Dain comes to my desk.*

morning3_date_seo_accept_b.name: {name}
morning3_date_seo_accept_b.text: *Back in class. One lesson later, another break.*

morning3_date_seo_decline.name: {name}
morning3_date_seo_decline.text: *When I turn down Seoyeon's offer, Dain starts twisting the water-bottle cap again.*

morning3_date_seo_decline_b.name: {name}
morning3_date_seo_decline_b.text: *Back in class. One lesson later, another break.*

morning3_date_dain_1.name: Dain
morning3_date_dain_1.text: Then it's my turn. Want to hit the arcade this weekend? The president isn't the only one allowed to ask.

morning3_date_dain_2.name: Dain
morning3_date_dain_2.text: I asked out loud. Better than a note, right? *She taps the desk edge.*

morning3_date_dain_choice.name: Dain
morning3_date_dain_choice.text: If you don't hate arcades, you could go with me. Don't just give the president an answer. *She leans down a little, waiting.*
choices: Sure, let's do it
This weekend might be tough.
Since you’re asking that hard, I’ll go.
Make it fun, and you’ve got a deal.

morning3_date_dain_accept.name: {name}
morning3_date_dain_accept.text: Okay. See you at the arcade. *Dain smiles; Seoyeon closes her clipboard.*

morning3_date_dain_decline.name: Dain
morning3_date_dain_decline.text: Oh, yeah? Can't help it if you're busy! It's not because the president asked first, is it?

morning3_date_dain_decline_narr.name: Dain
morning3_date_dain_decline_narr.text: Okay. Let's just get to class. *She smiles and returns to her seat. Just before the bell, she taps once inside her pocket.*

morning3_date_dain_decline_inner_2.name: {name}
morning3_date_dain_decline_inner_2.text: *Dain returns to her seat. The classroom before the bell.*

morning3_date_yuna_1.name: {name}
morning3_date_yuna_1.text: *Just before lunch, Yuna sets a folded note on my desk. Seoyeon and Dain look at her hand at the same time.*

morning3_date_yuna_1_b.name: Seoyeon
morning3_date_yuna_1_b.text: Yuna. If you ask by note, nobody else can hear you.

morning3_date_yuna_2.name: Yuna
morning3_date_yuna_2.text: *The note reads.* Weekend. Used bookstore. Even if you have plans already, come if you want to. — Yuna

morning3_date_yuna_choice.name: Yuna
morning3_date_yuna_choice.text: If saying it aloud matters, I'll say it now. I want your answer. *She looks at Seoyeon, then Dain, leaving her face uncovered.*
choices: Write “I'll go” on the back of the note
Write “I can't this weekend” on the back of the note
Write on the note, “If you don’t want to go alone, I’ll come with you.”
Write on the note, “I’ll go if we keep it secret from everyone else.”

morning3_date_yuna_accept.name: {name}
morning3_date_yuna_accept.text: *I write my answer on the back and return the note. Yuna reads it, folds it and slips it into her book.*

morning3_date_yuna_decline.name: {name}
morning3_date_yuna_decline.text: *I write my answer on the back of the note and place it on her book. Yuna slips in her bookmark, then reads the sentence.*

morning3_set_multiple.name: {name}
morning3_set_multiple.text: *Weekend plans overlap. Unable to choose whom to tell first, I close the calendar.*

morning3_end.name: {name}
morning3_end.text: *The bell ending class rings. Lunch is about to begin.*

morning3_gate_none_1.name: {name}
morning3_gate_none_1.text: *Nobody is waiting at the gate. The late bell rings first.*

morning3_seo_gate_neg_1.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_neg_1.text: *She walks past without even checking the name tag.*

morning3_seo_gate_neg_2.name: {name}
morning3_seo_gate_neg_2.text: *Seoyeon's shoes disappear through the gate first.*

morning3_yuna_gate_neg_1.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_neg_1.text: *Yuna turns her head away before our eyes meet and walks through the gate. No note, either.*

morning3_dain_gate_neg_1.name: Dain
morning3_dain_gate_neg_1.text: *She runs in with her friends and doesn't look this way.*

morning3_dain_gate_neg_2.name: {name}
morning3_dain_gate_neg_2.text: *No greeting until Dain's bag disappears around the corner.*

morning3_date_seo_neg.name: Seoyeon
morning3_date_seo_neg.text: *She walks past with the clipboard against her chest.* Weekend schedule goes in the group chat only. Don't ask separately.

morning3_date_dain_neg.name: Dain
morning3_date_dain_neg.text: *She zips her bag all the way.* Don't call this weekend. I'm practicing alone.

morning3_date_yuna_neg.name: Yuna
morning3_date_yuna_neg.text: *She starts to take out a note, then puts it back between the pages.* Don't look for me this weekend.
